inj.note: The left tackle was initially issued a two-game suspension for unsportsmanlike conduct for striking Bradley Chubb after the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night in Week 5. Jackson appealed the ruling and had the ban cut to one game, which has now been served.

news.h: Rams' Alaric Jackson has suspension cut to 1 game following appeal
news.d: Alaric Jackson's suspension for punching Bradley Chubb after Monday night's game between the Bills and Rams has been reduced from two games to one.

news.h: Bills' Bradley Chubb details his side of altercation with Rams' Alaric Jackson
news.d: Bills edge defender Bradley Chubb gave his side of the story two days after a postgame altercation with Rams offensive tackle Alaric Jackson.
